Best for quick, human-readable summaries. Synthesizes the web into a short, conversational answer with citations.

Part of [`seek web`](seek-web.md).

## Usage

```text
seek web perplexity [options] <query...>
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Required | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `query...` | Yes, one or more | Question or query |  |

## Options

| Option | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--model <name>` | Override model (default: sonar; sonar-pro, sonar-reasoning, etc. also work) |  |
| `--recency <window>` | Restrict sources by recency: hour \| day \| week \| month |  |
| `--mode <mode>` | Search mode: web (default) \| academic |  |
| `--domains <list>` | Comma-separated allow-list of domains |  |
| `--max-tokens <n>` | Cap response tokens |  |
| `--json` | Emit raw JSON response |  |
| `-h, --help` | display help for command |  |

## Exit statuses

`seek web perplexity` exits with one of the [exit statuses of `seek`](seek.md#exit-statuses).

## Help

The output of `seek web perplexity --help`:
